correctness.rationale: The signed-binary construction is correct. The selected doubling chain and partial-sum relations force every response to be the corresponding integer multiple of the first response, and either closing relation forces p times that response to be zero. In a distinct prime-order target this forces the first response to the identity, contradicting preservation of its source inequality. The popcount identity s2(a)+s2(2^n-a)=n-v2(a)+1 yields h(p)<=ceil(n/2). Gomaa's Theorem 3.3 independently supplies the n+1 lower bound for every prime p<q with 2^n<p<2^{n+1}. The package verifier was inspected and an independent finite replay confirmed the combinatorial inequality; the all-prime conclusion rests on the symbolic proof.
